# Reviewed docs-only documents (ANYM-323, scripts/docs_only.py). A pull request run whose every changed path is
# one of these exact repository paths, and whose scan of every tracked non-Markdown file finds no consumer, skips
# the test jobs. Add an entry only after a review finds that no test, script, packaging file, Dockerfile or workflow
# of any module reads it, directly or through a composed path such as ROOT / "docs" / "guide.md", and that no
# tracked non-Markdown file names it (the scan refuses any such file, comment or not, outside Python comments).
# README.md, SETUP.md, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and licenses are never listed. Left out because a file names them:
# TIDEN-CI.md and docs/operations/production.md (workflows), CODEX_ENRICHMENT.md (a messaging docstring), AGENTS.md
# (services/calendar/pyproject.toml, for its own copy), TELEMETRY.md (Dockerfile comments), CONTRIBUTING.md (the
# vendored gitleaks config) and SENDING.md (the deedkit npm client).

## scan exclusions
# <path> | <reason>. Each entry skips only the directory or glob check of that file, after a review found that its
# listing and docs/Markdown matches read no listed document; the file is still refused if it names a changed one.
.github/workflows/production-release.yml | a comment names docs/operations/production.md, which is not listed; it lists no documents
services/calendar/pyproject.toml | its sdist include list is relative to services/calendar and names that service's own docs
scripts/docs_only.py | the guard's own pattern literals
scripts/tiden_drift.py | the drift job's exclusion patterns and its spec listing flag; it reads no document
tests/test_docs_only.py | the guard's tests: synthetic repositories under tmp_path and the guard's pattern literals
tests/test_tiden_drift.py | synthetic repositories under tmp_path and the drift job's exclusion patterns; it reads no document
tests/test_seamless_release.py | docs is a local variable holding parsed Compose documents; it lists release state, not Markdown
tests/test_tiden_ci.py | synthetic repositories under tmp_path for the image change detection and evidence tests
scripts/change_path.py | classifies changed paths by name and reads only AGENTS.md, .claude/settings.json, the ruleset and workflows at two revisions; no listed document
tests/test_change_path.py | synthetic repositories under tmp_path and the classifier's path literals; it reads no listed document
